if [ ! -f /var/lib/secure-volume/key ]; then dd if=/dev/urandom of=/var/lib/secure-volume/key bs=64 count=1 status=none; chmod 0400 /var/lib/secure-volume/key; fi
if [ ! -f /var/lib/secure-volume/volume.luks ]; then fallocate -l 1G /var/lib/secure-volume/volume.luks; chmod 0600 /var/lib/secure-volume/volume.luks; fi

if ! blkid /dev/mapper/secure_crypt >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkfs.xfs -f -L secure_data /dev/mapper/secure_crypt; fi

command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d
install -m 0400 /var/lib/secure-volume/key /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_crypt.key
rm -f /var/lib/secure-volume/key
restorecon -RF /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d /var/lib/secure-volume
printf 'secure_crypt /var/lib/secure-volume/volume.luks /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_crypt.key luks\n' >> /etc/crypttab
install -d -m 0750 /srv/secure
printf '/dev/mapper/secure_crypt /srv/secure xfs defaults 0 0\n' >> /etc/fstab
systemctl daemon-reload
mount /srv/secure
printf 'encrypted-volume-ok\n' > /srv/secure/boot-persistence.txt
sync
printf 'CRYPTTAB_ENTRY\n'; grep '^secure_crypt ' /etc/crypttab
printf 'FSTAB_ENTRY\n'; grep '^/dev/mapper/secure_crypt ' /etc/fstab
printf 'MOUNT\n'; findmnt -no SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /srv/secure
printf 'KEY_MODE='; stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_crypt.key
printf 'DATA='; cat /srv/secure/boot-persistence.txt
